content: जरा [जॄ-अङ् गुणः] (The word जरस् is optionally substituted for जरा before vowel terminations after <ab>acc.</ab> dual.) .²1 Old age; कैकेयीशङ्कयेवाह पलितच्छद्मना जरा <ls>R. 12. 2</ls>; तस्य धर्मरतेरासीद् वृद्धत्वं जरया (जरसा) विना <ls n="R.">1. 23</ls>. .²2 Decrepitude, infirmity, general debility consequent on old age. .²3 Praise. .²4 Digestion. .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of a female demon; see जरासन्ध below. .²6 Invoking, greeting.
